1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.Bb5+ Nc6 4.O-O.strategy: Castles and keeps the bishop on b5, where it still pins the knight, instead of exchanging at once. White makes the king safe, keeps the threat of doubling Black's pawns, and decides the bishop's fate once Black has shown its set-up.

1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.Bb5+ Nc6 4.O-O Bd7.strategy: Breaks the pin and takes the sting out of an exchange on c6: Black can now recapture with the bishop and keep a healthy pawn structure. White's bishop has lost its target, and White must decide what it is for.
